## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete requirement or problem and what this change makes possible.
Link the engineering task or problem report where applicable.

## Design impact

Identify affected requirements, interfaces, candidate parts, calculations, or manufacturing files.
For a hardware change, name the design revision and explain any changed electrical limits or wiring.
Update the board plan and affected guides together when a requirement changes.

## Validation and remaining work

Record the checks actually run, their conditions and outcomes, and the saved evidence.
State checks that remain pending. A document audit or skipped native-design check does not qualify hardware.

For a manufacturing release, link the completed release checklist and matching schematic, PCB,
BOM, placement files, fabrication outputs, and review reports.
